info.name: SIH26187 Border Surveillance API
info.description:
Ministry of Home Affairs / SSB AI border surveillance backend (Week 2).

Run Auth > Login first: it stores access_token and refresh_token as variables that every other request uses. Access tokens expire after 15 minutes; use Auth > Refresh access token.

Roles: admin > regional_head > supervisor > operator. Delete operations are admin only.

item.name: System
item.description: Unauthenticated service endpoints used by monitoring.

request.description: Service name, version and environment.
Liveness plus a real SELECT 1 against PostgreSQL.
healthy / degraded / down, including camera monitor state. Used by uptime monitoring.

item.name: Auth
item.description: JWT login, refresh, profile, logout and password change. All rate limited.

request.description: OAuth2 password form. Saves access_token and refresh_token into the environment. Three wrong passwords lock the account for 30 minutes.
Exchange the refresh token for a new 15 minute access token.
Current user. Never contains password_hash.
Requires the current password. New password: 12+ chars with upper, lower, digit and symbol.
Audits the logout and revokes the token when JWT_BLACKLIST_ENABLED=True.

item.name: Cameras
item.description: Camera registration, listing, status and stream testing.

request.description: Supervisor or above. The server generates camera_id (CAM-N-001 style) and probes the stream; a camera whose stream cannot be verified is saved as degraded.
Cameras with the most unacknowledged alerts first. Non-admins see only their granted cameras/regions.

Supervisor or above. Position of the console host from the Windows location service, used to locate cameras attached to this machine when the browser has no geolocation. 503 with the reason when location is off. Cached for a minute (refresh=true bypasses). Audited as READ_HOST_LOCATION.
Camera detail with live viewer count and the last 5 alerts.
Supervisor or above. Setting offline raises a camera_offline alert and notifies every operator.
Supervisor or above. Edits name, location, GPS, sector, type or region. Only the fields sent change; gps_lat and gps_lng must be sent together (null clears both). Audited as EDIT_CAMERA.
Supervisor or above. Opens the stream, measures FPS and returns a base64 JPEG preview.
Admin only. Refused with 409 when evidence exists; decommissioned (soft) when alerts/events exist.

item.name: Alerts
item.description: Alert triage: list, inspect, acknowledge, statistics and deletion.

request.description: Unacknowledged first, then newest first.
Totals for today plus breakdowns by type, risk level, camera and hour (IST).
Admin only. Acknowledges every unacknowledged alert raised before today (IST) as a false alarm noted as test data. Nothing is deleted: evidence references alerts.
Full alert record including risk reasons.
Operator or above. acknowledged_by must be your own user_id unless you are admin. Broadcasts alert_acknowledged over WebSocket.
Admin only. Refused with 409 when evidence is attached.
Everything currently on camera (is_active=true).
Filterable event history, newest first.
Every event for one track id, with totals. Add camera_id because track ids repeat per camera.
Ordered positions with zone and risk at each point, from tracked_objects.

item.name: Evidence
item.description: Chain of custody: upload, verify, archive, delete.

request.description: Supervisor or above. Multipart upload, max 500 MB. The SHA-256 is computed while the bytes are streamed to disk and the magic bytes must match the extension.
Newest first, with a file_url and file_exists flag.
Evidence record plus its authenticated file URL.
Recomputes the SHA-256 on disk and compares it: valid / tampered / missing.
Browser-playable video. Returns the original when it is H.264/VP8, otherwise a cached H.264 preview derived from it (the evidence file and its SHA-256 are never modified).
Supervisor or above. Runs YOLOv8x over the video in a worker process; high-risk and critical findings become alerts with SHA-256-verified snapshots. One analysis runs at a time (409 otherwise).
Latest analysis job for this evidence: status, percent, live counts and the final summary.
Progress of any analysis job by id (poll every 2 s).
Supervisor or above. Analyses a video that belongs to no camera: no zones, and no alerts or evidence are stored. The uploaded file is deleted when the analysis ends.
Authenticated static serving. Works with the Bearer header or ?token= for tags. Every download is audited.
Admin only. Verifies the hash, then moves the file to cold storage.
Admin only. Removes the record and the file.

item.name: Zones
item.description: Detection zones. risk_bonus is policy, derived from zone_type.

request.description: Supervisor or above. Polygon needs 3+ integer pixel points. risk_bonus is set from zone_type: public 0, buffer 10, sensitive 30, restricted 50, no_mans_land 100.
All zones visible to you.
Active zones of one camera.
Supervisor or above. Broadcasts zone_update to everyone watching the camera.
Supervisor or above. Sets is_active=false and broadcasts zone_deleted.

item.name: Hardware
item.description: Hardware registry. Connection passwords are always masked in responses.

request.description: Every hardware type with connected/disconnected/error/standby counts and masked configs.
Admin only. connection_config is stored as given but never returned in clear text.

request.description: Supervisor or above. Cameras are probed with OpenCV, other devices with an HTTP request. Updates status and last_seen.
Admin only. Sending back the masked '***' keeps the stored secret unchanged.
Admin only.

item.name: Stats
item.description: Live metrics, audit trail and health history.

request.description: Detection counts for today, alert and camera counts, FPS, CPU/RAM/GPU/disk and uptime.
Admin only. Every action in the system is recorded here.
Admin or regional head. Samples recorded every 60 seconds by the background service.
